<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Coco – Ich habe mich verlaufen</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#f0f4fb;--card:#fff;--text:#0f1a3a;--muted:#5a6785;--accent:#2f86d6;--ok:#1f9d55;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0e1424;--card:#192139;--text:#eef2fb;--muted:#9aa7c7;--accent:#5aa8f0;--ok:#4cc98a}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0e1424;--card:#192139;--text:#eef2fb;--muted:#9aa7c7;--accent:#5aa8f0;--ok:#4cc98a}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.45}
main{max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 32px}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:12px 0 8px}
.photo{width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:4px solid var(--card);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
h1{margin:4px 0;font-size:34px}
.sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.alert{background:var(--card);border-left:5px solid var(--accent);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin:16px 0;font-size:17px}
.call{display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--ok);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:20px;padding:18px;border-radius:14px;margin:12px 0}
.call small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:14px;opacity:.9}
.card{background:var(--card);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;margin:12px 0}
h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:15px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted)}
dl{margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:6px 14px}
dt{color:var(--muted)}dd{margin:0;font-weight:600;word-break:break-word}
a{color:var(--accent)}
.call.wa{background:#25a244}.call.loc{background:var(--accent);width:100%;border:0;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}.call.mail{background:var(--card);color:var(--text);font-size:17px;padding:14px}.hint{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:-4px 0 8px;min-height:0}.full{width:100%;border-radius:14px;display:block;margin-top:12px}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin-top:20px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main>
<div class="hero"><img class="photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,



#
